prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one polished, high-resolution PORTRAIT 2:3 Android product feature image for a startup pitch deck, 1024 x 1536 or larger matching ratio. A single elegant front-facing Android phone with thin silver frame and subtle centered punch-hole, occupying most of the canvas, centered on a clean very light pearl-gray studio backdrop with a delicate grounding shadow. The UI is the original Monolog Android app, not a reproduction of the reference.
Visual reference 1 is material/color inspiration only: frosted glass, misty steel-blue and silver, pale periwinkle, pearl-gray with a barely noticeable warm blush reflection. Reference 2 is Monolog's established borderless keyboard style and brand. White-first UI, dark charcoal readable text, desaturated blurred aurora at left and right corners, milky translucent rounded cards with subtle depth. Professional restrained Android design, not an iPhone. Clear typography, realistic spacing, readable concise English. Brand at top: small M keycap with diary-page edges and "Monolog". Use consistent original design across images. No duplicated controls, garbled text, irrelevant logos, watermark or exterior marketing text. All sample weather, reminders, conversations and memories are illustrative UI content.
Feature: JOURNAL HOME / TODAY DASHBOARD.
Top app header "Monolog", small shield and "On-device". Directly below a compact weather row: sun/cloud icon, "24°", "Partly cloudy", "Today · Sun, 15 Nov". Greeting "Your day, remembered".
Prioritize a large glass journal card across the top of the content: book icon, "Today's journal", short preview "A quiet morning, a good conversation, and a little progress.", small "Continue writing" link.
Below a balanced two-column layout of original modular tiles:
1 "Reminders", clock icon, "Call Amma", "6:00 PM".
2 "Memory of the day", sparkle/bookmark icon, a tiny warm coffee photo, "Coffee with Sam".
3 "Context library", tasteful three overlapping screenshot/photo thumbnails, "Photos, notes & screenshots", small "View all".
4 A clearly visible plus icon tile labeled "Add a card" with sublabel "Make this space yours".
Persistent bottom frosted rounded chat composer with plus button at left, placeholder "Ask about your day…", microphone button at right. Very bottom minimal navigation "Today", "Journal", "Library", with Today selected. Don't show keyboard in this home image. All features visible without overcrowding. Original asymmetric journal-first hierarchy, not six copied reference widgets.
